description: Deletes an internal note from a thread, and the files it carried with it: a note left on the wrong thread, or one that is no longer true. It cannot be undone; to fix a word, update_note keeps the note. Allowed to the author of the note and to a manager or the owner of the account; anyone else is refused. One note at a time.

conversation_id.description: The id of the conversation, as list_conversations gives it.

note_id.description: The id of the note, as "notes" of get_conversation gives it.

name: delete_note
title: Delete an internal note
